reviews.text: "S.O.S. emergency" pads for days when your skin is acting up or feeling overheated. They aren't just toners; they are pre-soaked mini-sheet masks that deliver a massive dose of serum (220ml per tub!) in just 3–5 minutes. The cooling sensation is instant and incredibly refreshing, making them a perfect morning prep step to reduce puffiness and help makeup sit more smoothly. While they are powerful against redness, they are surprisingly gentle and don't cause the dryness often associated with acne treatments. The thinness of the pads is a huge plus—they stay exactly where you put them, allowing you to move around or style your hair while they work their magic.
reviews.zh: 「S.O.S. emergency」棉片，適合皮膚出狀況或者感到發熱嗰時用。佢哋唔單止係化妝水；而係預先浸好嘅迷你布面膜，喺 3 至 5 分鐘內可以為皮膚供應大量精華（每罐 220ml！）。涼感即時出現，清爽得令人難以置信，令佢成為朝早嘅完美準備步驟，幫助減少浮腫，令化妝更加服貼。雖然對紅位效果強勁，但係出奇地溫和，唔會引致通常同暗瘡療程有關嘅乾燥問題。棉片好薄係一大優點，貼咗之後會穩穩貼住位置，令你可以走動或者整頭髮，同時佢哋發揮功效。

reviews.text: These toner pads are a great addition to my skincare routine. They provide excellent hydration and help reduce redness on the skin. After using them, my skin feels calm, refreshed, and well-balanced. The pads are gentle and do not irritate the skin. They are also very efficient, as one pad is enough for the whole face. I am very satisfied with their performance and would recommend them.
reviews.zh: 呢款化妝水棉片係我護膚程序入面一個好好嘅新增產品。佢哋補水效果好好，又有助減少皮膚紅位。用咗之後，皮膚感覺平靜、清爽、平衡。棉片溫和，唔會刺激皮膚。佢哋效率都好高，一片就已經夠晒成張面。我對佢哋嘅表現好滿意，會推薦畀其他人。

reviews.text: best product ever for my red skin, I use it at night mostly and leave it on my skin for 10 mnt (like a mask), my sling goes from angry red to clear skin. it’s my 2nd time ordering it and I will again next time ❤️ it really calms my skin and it make it smoother too
reviews.zh: 係我紅皮膚用過最好嘅產品，我多數晚上用，留喺皮膚上十分鐘（好似面膜咁），我嘅 sling 由紅到發火變返清晰嘅皮膚。呢次係我第二次訂購，下次我會再買 ❤️ 佢真係令皮膚平靜，而且仲令皮膚更加幼滑。

reviews.text: i’ve been wanting to try these specific pads for awhile and i’m soo happy i finally did :D they’re super soaked in serum and one pad can be moved to different parts of your face in one skincare session without drying out. my skin feels really plumped and hydrated after just one 🥕🥕
reviews.zh: 我一直都想試吓呢款棉片，終於試咗，好開心 :D 佢哋浸滿精華，一片棉片喺一次護膚過程中可以移去面上唔同位置，而且唔會乾。只係用咗一片之後，皮膚已經感覺好飽滿、水潤 🥕🥕

reviews.text: I absolutely adore this cleansing balm! It's transformed my nightly skincare routine into a luxurious, spa-like experience. The way it effortlessly melts away every trace of makeup, even stubborn waterproof mascara and heavy SPF, is truly impressive. It starts as a solid balm, then transforms into a silky oil as I massage it into my skin, and finally emulsifies into a milky cleanser with a touch of water. My skin feels incredibly soft, hydrated, and perfectly clean afterward, never stripped or tight. It's gentle, effective, and leaves my complexion glowing. A definite holy grail product!
reviews.zh: 我真係超級鍾意呢款潔面膏！佢將我晚上嘅護膚程序變成一種奢華、好似做 SPA 咁嘅體驗。佢可以輕易溶走所有化妝痕跡，連頑固嘅防水睫毛膏同厚身嘅防曬都做到，真係好厲害。佢先係固體膏狀，然後我按摩喺皮膚上嗰時變成絲滑嘅油，最後加少少水乳化成奶白色嘅潔面產品。之後皮膚感覺非常柔軟、水潤，而且好清潔，從來唔會覺得乾身或者緊繃。佢溫和、有效，令膚色有光澤。絕對係一件「holy grail」級產品！

reviews.text: These calming toner pads are an absolute game-changer! I genuinely love them. They deliver an instant wave of soothing relief to my skin, making any redness or irritation visibly calm down. The pre-soaked pads are so convenient – just swipe and go! My skin feels incredibly comfortable and balanced after using them, never tight or sticky. They're perfect for sensitive skin and have become an essential step in my routine for maintaining a healthy, tranquil complexion.
reviews.zh: 呢款舒緩化妝水棉片真係一個改變遊戲規則嘅產品！我真心好鍾意佢哋。佢即時為皮膚帶嚟一陣舒緩嘅感覺，令任何紅位或者刺激都明顯地平靜咗。預先浸好嘅棉片好方便，一抹就得！用咗之後皮膚感覺非常舒適、平衡，從來唔會緊繃或者黏膩。佢哋啱敏感皮膚，已經成為我護膚程序入面一個必要步驟，令我保持健康、平靜嘅膚色。

reviews.text: These calming toner pads with carotene are an absolute treat for my skin! The pads are incredibly soothing and leave my face feeling refreshed and calm. Carotene works wonders to nourish and restore balance, and I’ve noticed a real improvement in the overall texture of my skin. They’re perfect for sensitive skin—gentle yet effective—helping to reduce redness and irritation. I love how convenient they are for quick, on-the-go skincare, and they leave my skin feeling hydrated and soft without any residue. If you’re looking for a calming toner pad that actually works, these are a must-try!
reviews.zh: 呢款含有胡蘿蔔素嘅舒緩化妝水棉片，對我嘅皮膚嚟講真係一大享受！棉片好舒緩，用完令面感覺清新、平靜。胡蘿蔔素效果好好，有助滋養同重建平衡，我留意到皮膚整體質地真係有改善。佢哋啱敏感皮膚，溫和但有效，有助減少紅位同刺激。我鍾意佢哋方便，可以隨時隨地快速護膚，用完皮膚感覺水潤、柔軟，又冇殘留。如果你想搵一款真係有效嘅舒緩化妝水棉片，呢款絕對要試吓！

reviews.text: i use these whenever i notice my skin getting a bit red! these calm my skin down sooo fast and the slightly milky texture of the toner/serum feels so nice on the skin <3 the pads are literally DRENCHED in product so i usually use two and put them on my cheeks, then use the rest of the product all over my face n neck, sometimes my hands too
reviews.zh: 我留意到皮膚開始有少少紅嗰時，就會用呢款！佢哋令我嘅皮膚好快冷靜落嚟，而且化妝水／精華微微奶白嘅質地塗喺皮膚上好舒服 <3 棉片真係浸到滴晒產品，所以我通常用兩片，貼喺面頰位置，然後將剩低嘅產品塗喺成面同頸，有時連手都會塗。

note: 以下評價由 YesStyle 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
